verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs say users can connect MCP servers as a knowledge source, so it can pull context from documentation, design, and project-management tools during reviews and chat. The pricing page also lists "MCP connections" as a feature, which confirms this is a first-party client capability. Missing for 10: setup and configuration detail (supported transports, auth), evidence that CodeRabbit can invoke action-taking MCP tools beyond reading context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
